# Project instructions

Before making changes in this repository:

- Read [`CLAUDE.md`](../CLAUDE.md) and follow its project conventions.
- Check the skills in [`.claude/skills/`](../.claude/skills/). When a skill matches the task, read its `SKILL.md` and the relevant references before working. For Angular development, use [the Angular developer skill](../.claude/skills/angular-developer/SKILL.md); for creating a new Angular application, use [the Angular new-app skill](../.claude/skills/angular-new-app/SKILL.md).
- Keep changes focused, preserve existing behavior, and run the relevant validation commands described by the skill and project.
